geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the single compact bent bar into a better neighborhood-living massing with a ground-level opening while preserving a dominant anchor.
Keep the split legible along the long axis of the site frame.
Create a meaningful but not excessive void so the ground edge can read as a public threshold.
Retain continuity between wings so the object stays coherent rather than becoming fragmented.
Introduce a grounded base condition to support the active street threshold and keep the composition anchored.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the primary mass language from a generic courtyard seed to an explicit carved void strategy so the ground threshold can become legible without fragmenting the dominant body.
Increase the void scale modestly so the public opening is perceivable as usable space rather than a minor bite.
Align the primary public opening to the verified access side in the program frame.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass across all four views, with a single dominant bent/wedge-like body and no obvious view-to-view collisions. It responds to the parcel in a roughly contained way and avoids simple boxiness. However, the public edge is weak: the blue frontage is acknowledged only indirectly, with no strong undercut, court, or entry seam clearly opening to that access side. The mass is program-plausible for neighborhood living/commercial mixed use, but the section is still somewhat sculptural rather than clearly organized around active ground and usable public void. Overall this is a viable early massing with a clear dominant gesture, but it needs a stronger ground threshold and void logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is taller and more tower-like than the candidate; the candidate is much lower and more compact.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact prism can be made legible through one dominant mass with a controlled taper/step and a clear civic reading.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology and scale are not directly transferable to neighborhood living massing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A subtly torqued or slumped vertical profile can create hierarchy without fragmenting the mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is flatter and more pavilion-like; the candidate has a more sculpted compact body.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low commercial mass can work when it pairs a calm primary volume with a strong ground-level public threshold or entry condition.

warnings: The verified access edge is not made legibly public; frontage response remains modest.
The void/court logic is present in concept but not strongly expressed as usable public space in the current silhouette.
Do not overread the stepped/profiled top as a fully justified section strategy; it is only moderately program-specific.
